source.name: Wanted Design System Community
source.inspectionMethod: Figma MCP metadata and use_figma page-section inspection
limitations: Figma MCP Starter plan rate limit stopped subsection title extraction during this pass.
Rows with status `partial` or `needs-detail-audit` require a later node-level pass before they can be treated as complete.

statusLegend.covered: The WDS section has an LDS story, token, component, or document contract that directly covers the same design-system role.
statusLegend.theme-overridden: The WDS role is intentionally retained, but color, logo, or brand expression is replaced by LK ROBOTICS theme values.
statusLegend.partial: The LDS has relevant coverage, but the WDS node-level variants or examples have not all been verified.
statusLegend.needs-detail-audit: The top-level WDS section is known, but exact subsection-level coverage still needs Figma node extraction.
statusLegend.not-covered: No LDS coverage has been identified.

sections.notes: The local WDS icon export folder is imported into assets/icons and exposed through Icon/ICON_NAMES. Full glyph parity still needs direct Figma node-level audit.
WDS logo structure is intentionally replaced by LK ROBOTICS marks while retaining a dedicated brand/theme layer.
Color, typography, radius, and PDF-confirmed Basic/Ratio foundations are mapped. Full WDS Basic node-level examples still need audit.
Base spacing, grid, and PDF-confirmed Safe Area Status/Bottom examples are represented. Remaining spacing subsections require a detail pass.
PDF-confirmed Gradient, Mask, and Interaction tokens are represented. Other WDS decorative examples still need node-level comparison.
Local PDF confirms WDS Layout Essential and Divider. Page-level layout primitives are covered, but remaining WDS layout subsection parity is not yet proven.

Local PDF confirms Action Area, Button, Text Button, Icon Button, Chip, and Toggle Icon. Button and action-control families are covered, while exact variant-level parity still needs a Figma detail audit.

User-provided source screenshot confirms the visible WDS groups Textinput, Select, Control, Segmented Control, and Framed Style. Input, select, check mark, switch, segmented, and framed-style roles are represented through existing LDS components and state matrices, including Checkbox variant="mark" and ChoiceCard presentation="frame"; exact WDS child-node properties still need direct Figma node-level audit.

Text, list, media, card, badges, disclosure, annotation, and avatar content are represented. User-provided WDS Avatar Resource assets and Avatar PDF are mirrored in the existing Avatar story and component props for person/company/academy variants, WDS size keys, placeholder, interaction, pushBadge, customize, deactivate, and Avatar Group trailingContent states. User-provided Content Card, Icon, Content Badge, Thumbnail, and List Cell PDFs are now mapped in COMPONENT_SOURCE_PDFS.json and reflected in the existing Card, Iconography, Content Badge, ContentMedia, and ContentLists stories. Exact Figma child-node parity still needs detail audit.

Loading, skeleton, spinner, progress, circular progress, and meter are represented. User-provided Loading PDF is now mapped in COMPONENT_SOURCE_PDFS.json and reflected in the existing Loading State story with Wanted loading, Circular loading, Skeleton Text length/align, Rectangle customization, and Circle customization axes. WDS state/size variant parity still needs detail audit.

Top bar, app navigation, compact navigation, tabs/routes, footer, menu, steps, and wizard coverage exists. User-provided Navigation Category, Tab, Page Indicator, and Pagination PDFs are now mapped in COMPONENT_SOURCE_PDFS.json and reflected in the existing NavigationFlow and NavigationCompact stories. Detail audit should verify WDS hover/collapse behavior and mobile navigation variants.

Alert, toast, snackbar, modal, confirm, empty, banner, callout, badge, avatar, and notification-like roles are represented. User-provided Toast, Snackbar, and Alert PDFs are now mapped in COMPONENT_SOURCE_PDFS.json and reflected in the existing Toast and Confirm Alert stories. Exact WDS feedback taxonomy needs confirmation.

Tooltip/menu/overlay presentation roles are represented. User-provided Tooltip and Menu PDFs are now mapped in COMPONENT_SOURCE_PDFS.json and reflected in the existing Annotations and Menu stories. WDS has three top-level children here; exact component names and states need node-level audit.

knownCoveredFindings.notes: Mobile status bar, home indicator, bottom bar, and bottom action safe-area spacing guidance added after direct Figma screenshot inspection and confirmed by local PDF export.

nextDetailAuditTargets: 1 Theme / 1 Icon: compare assets/icons/manifest.json and ICON_NAMES against the Figma source node.
2 Element / 1 Basic: PDF-confirmed Ratio is mapped; extract remaining Basic subsections and verify color, typography, radius, line, and fill semantics one by one.
2 Element / 3 Decorate: PDF-confirmed Gradient and Interaction are mapped; verify remaining radius, shadow/effect, and decorative treatment examples.
3 Component / 1 Layout: PDF-confirmed Essential and Divider are mapped; verify remaining layout subsections against layout primitives.

3 Component / 2 Action: PDF-confirmed Action Area and Toggle Icon are mapped; verify full WDS Action variants against Button, TextButton, IconButton, Chip, ToggleIcon, ButtonGroup, SplitButton, Fab, and SocialButton.

3 Component / 3 Selection and Input: screenshot confirms Textinput, Select, Control, Segmented Control, and Framed Style groups; local stories cover the visible state matrices through existing LDS components, but exact child-node properties still require Figma node reads.

3 Component / 6 Navigation: PDF-confirmed Category, Tab, Page Indicator, and Pagination are mapped; verify hover-collapse, mobile navigation, footer, menu, tabs, route, stepper, and wizard behavior against stories.
3 Component / 7 Feedback: PDF-confirmed Toast, Snackbar, and Alert are mapped; verify timeout, action, dismissal, and platform behavior against source nodes.
3 Component / 8 Presentation: PDF-confirmed Tooltip and Menu are mapped; verify Tooltip/Menu/Overlay roles and states.
